correctness.rationale: For the labeled 16-vertex 24-edge GP(8,3), conditional next-dimer probabilities are exactly proportional to active Poisson attempt rates. Differentiation of the terminating finite recursion yields rational jets through order two, whose terminal boundary conditions uniquely determine all values. The vertex-mask enumeration exhausts 7,314 states and independently implemented deposited-edge-mask enumeration exhausts 11,068 states; both reproduce the exact baseline probability 903422/3840375, both zero first derivatives, and opposite nonzero second derivatives 276830066540632837/4793798789772300000 and -561926341371011/43579988997930000. The full three-point terminal-size distribution is also normalized exactly. Analyticity for t>0 makes the opposite strict local extrema rigorous. Both verification source programs are included and executable with the Python 3 standard library.

value.rationale: The Möbius–Kantor graph is the smallest unique sixteen-vertex cubic symmetric graph; all 24 edge locations are symmetry-equivalent before rate perturbation. Marking eight ring edges or eight disjoint spoke edges makes a physically natural comparison of patterned reaction channels with equal total count. Their exact opposite signed curvatures demonstrate a geometric second-order effect invisible to homogeneous rate symmetry, connecting reaction-rate design to kinetic perfect coverage. This provides an exact structural counterexample to naive count-only response and a reproducible finite adsorption benchmark; it is not merely a renamed model or an arbitrary table entry.
